title: Compact Operational Panel: Route & Model Health Widgets and Token Flow Charts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Objective: Design a compact, scan-friendly operational panel for per-route and per-model health that surfaces latency, throughput, token-level metrics, cost signals, and rollout status in a single glance. Scope: deliver responsive widget layouts for list and detail views, microcharts for token flow and tail-latency, interaction states for canary/cutover rollouts, and a library of chart specs and tokens-cost mapping rules. Deliverables: 1) Wireframes for compact row + expanded detail, 2) Figma prototype with interactive thresholds and tooltip variants, 3) Chart specs (series, aggregation, sampling, refresh cadence), 4) Acceptance criteria and performance budget for rendering under large route lists. Constraints & trade-offs: compactness requires reducing chart density — priority is to keep 3 signal tiers (primary: latency p50/p95, throughput rps, token-rate; secondary: token-cost per 1k tokens, cache hit ratio; tertiary: error-rate). Visual noise must be minimized to preserve scan speed for on-call and platform teams. Accessibility: color choices follow contrast 4.5:1 for key status indicators; charts must have textual alternatives on hover and keyboard focus. Localization: numeric formats follow locale but units (ms, rps, tokens) remain constant. Performance: component renders should not exceed 80ms for lists of 200 routes (mock target). Acceptance criteria: - Compact row shows 3 compact microcharts + status chip + rollout pill. - Expanded pane shows 7-day sparkline with P50 and P95 overlays, token histogram, and cost delta. - Tooltips show exact aggregates and link to trace or log view. - Handoff-ready Figma file and chart-spec table included. Implementation notes: use existing microchart components where possible, add new aggregation endpoints as needed (ENG-20122), implement streaming data socket for near-realtime updates (ENG-20210).
chart_specs: Latency Sparkline (compact): type=line area-smoothed; metrics=p50,p95,p99; aggregation=1m; y-axis=latency(ms) linear; x-axis=7d; overlay=threshold line at SLO (configurable); tooltip=timestamp + values + sample-count; refresh=30s for visible widgets, 5m otherwise; sampling=adaptive downsample with max 500 points.

Throughput MiniBar: type=bar; metrics=requests_per_second (rps) aggregated per 1m; x-axis=1h for compact, 7d for expanded; y-axis=rps linear; tooltip=rate + 95th token length; refresh=15s; stacking=breakdown by model-variant when expanded.

Token Flow Histogram: type=histogram; metric=generated_tokens per-request bucketed by token-count ranges (0-64,65-256,257-1024,>1024); view=last 24h; tooltip=bucket-count + percent; color=single accent with highlighted top bucket; refresh=1m.

Cost Delta Spark: type=area with baseline; metric=estimated_cost_per_hour; aggregate=sum over hour; overlay=previous-period comparison (24h vs 24h prior) with % delta badge; color=green/red delta; refresh=5m.

Tail Latency Waterfall (expanded): type=stacked area; metrics=queue_time + service_time + decode_time per percentile; percentiles=[p50,p90,p95,p99]; x-axis=last 1h with 1m buckets; tooltip=breakdown per stage + trace link; privacy=redact customer prompt text in shared views.
Cache Hit Gauge: type=gauge micro; metric=kv_cache_hit_rate; range=0-100%; status thresholds=good>=90,warning>=70,critical<70; refresh=60s; accessible label="Cache hit rate percent".

Error Rate MiniTrend: type=line glam; metric=errors_per_minute and error_percentage; y-axis=percent; x-axis=24h; anomaly flagging=detect >3sigma deviation over baseline with small dot marker and drill link to error logs.
